author: Pedritx
quote: Un juego que ofrece 15 horas a lo sumo y poco más. Es repetitivo, muy sencillo, no tiene mecánicas, y a los 30 minutos ya prácticamente has aprendido todo. Los jefes finales super sencillos de matar. Un coñazo básicamente. Mucho mejor su versión original, esto es una copia barata.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Pedritx
quote: Juego terminado y con mucho contenido adicional por delante he de decir que es una obra maestra. Únicamente he perdido estabilidad en la primera misión del juego y ninguna vez más aún juntándose muchos enemigos y vehículos en una zona concurrida. Gráficos de 10 y jugabilidad de 10, lo he disfrutado mucho. Lo recomiendo al 100%.

author: Pedritx
quote: I've been playing for about 10 hours, and so far it lives up to all my expectations. The graphics are incredible, the combat is addictive and very well done. The story slowly draws you in, and you want to know more and more. I'm going to be really sad to finish it. Personally, there are only two things I don't like: it's quite linear, and it seems like a short game that you'll finish in about 50 hours. This last bit is a personal thing, but it doesn't make the game any less impressive. 10/10.

author: Pedritx
quote: It's a great game, an adaptation of 10 of the original game. The only bad thing that I can review about the game and all those whose duration is less than 50 or 60 hours, is its high price. For the rest and being objective, it is a game of 10 despite the bad reviews it is receiving from some players.
